nodes.name: EXTRA MAGAZINE
nodes.text: Start every game with 8 bullet slots instead of 5.

nodes.name: DEEP MAGAZINE
nodes.text: Start every game with 12 bullet slots.

nodes.name: HOT LOADS
nodes.text: Start every game with faster bullets.

nodes.name: FULL BELTS
nodes.text: Start every game with 18 bullet slots.

nodes.name: AUTO FIRE LICENSE
nodes.text: Auto Fire appears in the shop for you.

nodes.name: TRIGGER SERVOS
nodes.text: Start every game with Auto Fire installed.

nodes.name: SUPER FIRE LICENSE
nodes.text: Super Auto Fire appears in the shop for you.

nodes.name: OVERDRIVEN SERVOS
nodes.text: Start every game with Super Auto Fire installed.

nodes.name: ROCKET PACK LICENSE
nodes.text: The Rocket Pack appears in the shop for you.

nodes.name: SPARE RACK
nodes.text: Start every game with 10 rockets.

nodes.name: FULL RACK
nodes.text: Start every game with 20 rockets.

nodes.name: ALIEN LOCK LICENSE
nodes.text: The Alien Lock appears in the shop for you.

nodes.name: MAGAZINE BAY
nodes.text: Start every game with 30 rockets.

nodes.name: FACTORY LOCK
nodes.text: Start every game with the Alien Lock installed.

nodes.name: TUNED THRUSTERS
nodes.text: Start every game one speed step up.

nodes.name: RACING THRUSTERS
nodes.text: Start every game two speed steps up.

nodes.name: PLATED HULL
nodes.text: Start every game with one armour charge.

nodes.name: EXTENDED TIMER
nodes.text: Bonus rounds start with extra time.

nodes.name: VECTOR THRUSTERS
nodes.text: Start every game three speed steps up.

nodes.name: REINFORCED HULL
nodes.text: Start every game with two armour charges.

nodes.name: MAX TIMER
nodes.text: Bonus-round timers start half filled.

nodes.name: SIGN-ON BONUS
nodes.text: Start every game with 250 cash.

nodes.name: INVESTOR
nodes.text: Start every game with 500 cash.

nodes.name: GEM COUNTER
nodes.text: The HUD counts your collected gems.

nodes.name: SECRET COUNTER
nodes.text: The HUD counts the secrets you have found.

nodes.name: SHOP TRIGGER LINK
nodes.text: Auto fire keeps working while you browse the shop.

nodes.name: WAR CHEST
nodes.text: Start every game with 1000 cash.

nodes.name: MISSILE STEALTH
nodes.text: Alien missiles no longer target you first.
